result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 4.04% (20.70% vs 16.66%).
Beat the benchmark in 72.4% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Flexi Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.03 vs benchmark 0.56, Sortino 1.29.
Defensive profile: beta 0.59 with 26% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 7.17% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.32).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -31.20% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans -17.65% to 100.06% (117.71 pp spread) — consistency score 83.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
